summary.text: Rebecca Bextel is the Constitution Party's candidate for governor, a small business owner who has lived in Wyoming for more than 20 years. She describes herself as a conservative choice and has focused on government accountability, energy, state sovereignty and gun and parental rights.

paragraphs.text: Rebecca Bextel was born in Alabama to parents who were Christian missionaries.
She has lived in Wyoming for more than 20 years, where she and her family built a small business and raised four daughters.
Bextel says she has worked to expose waste and abuse in government and to defend access to public lands.

Her campaign site presents her as a candidate who would defend the right to keep and bear arms, protect innocent life, and strengthen the authority of parents over their children's upbringing and education.
